title: Childhood on Bleecker Street with his grandmother
summary: Born in New York to an opera-touring father; after his mother died he was raised by his Italian grandmother on Bleecker Street with his brother and sister, learning English at public school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Uh, 314 East 33rd Street in New York City. And how long you stood there? Oh I don't remember, I was too little. I know I got pushed around a lot because my father was always on the road with the opera company. So... I wound up on Bleeker Street. That I remember. I was about four or five years old but the cops were always coming looking for me and my brother. And that's how I remember Bleecker Street.
And that's how I remember Bleeker Street.
What were you doing? Playing bass underage or something?

No, I didn't even know bass existed in those days. I was living with my grandmother. My father couldn't take care of us because my mother died so he sent for his mother from Italy and set her up in an apartment house on Bleeker Street to take care of my brother Freddy, my sister Elsa and me. And my grandmother didn't know a word in English so I had a hard time learning English until I went to school, you know.
Well where did you go to school?
Public school number one, 102 I think it was, something like that. New York, they numbered schools instead of names, you know.
And how long did this go on that you went to school in New York and told you how old?
